summary: Design bundle for giving Nora a generated sense of where she is and what she can do.
reason: Design documents only (design/self-awareness/); nothing Nora does in a room changes. Proposes a generated per-turn <presence> block from the room table and adapter health, and three room-awareness tools with separate disclosure tiers. Two operator decisions are open (unit boundary, proactive rendering); no code is written until they are made and the tool catalogue lands.
